units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:1:6">Y. Erub. III, 20ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:4:4">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Eruvin 28a:7">Erub. 28ᵃ</cite>.
